impact.reason: Constrains destructive process matching to avoid killing the invoking shell.

purpose.text: Keep a process-matching command from matching and killing its own shell.

revisions.text:
- `pkill -f <pattern>` also matches the shell running it, whose command line contains
  the pattern, and kills it: use `pkill -f '[p]attern'` or kill the pid you recorded.
